limitations.contribution: g_m * L2(P_m(normalized_x_m)); no shared bias; norm shares not causal or signed contributions
limitations.aggregation: per task/fold/model/node-type first, equal fold means; no independence of repeated nodes
limitations.removal: presence bit zero only in in-memory DGL local_scope; original graph/NPZ unchanged; gates recomputed
limitations.interpretation_threshold: code_only prediction changes <0.001 AND zero nonSolidiFI positive class changes
limitations.interpretation_limit: insensitivity to this intervention cannot prove nonuse; probability changes also reported
limitations.C_selection: highest inner_val ROC AUC; ties smallest C; no refit on inner_val
limitations.threshold_selection: redundancy=0.5; signal=max inner_val BF1, ties closest 0.5 then lower threshold
limitations.prevalence: task-wide available STATIC rows, inclusive 1%-99%, as prescribed; transductive unsupervised bit filter disclosed
limitations.population: redundancy=all available carrier nodes by frozen file split; signal=L-audit included nonSolidiFI original nodes with CODE+STATIC available
limitations.groups: full schema subgroup and A-N parent both retained
limitations.undefined: train/val empty or single-class not estimable; test single-class AUC/BA null, BF1 retained
limitations.inference: descriptive only; no significance claims; probes fit logistic coefficients only, never HGT
limitations.final_server: Separate future batch on adequate VRAM; local RTX3050 is current limitation
